title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on John 17: the prayer to the Father about glory, eternal life, and keeping the disciples as one.

questions.text: What did Jesus do before he said, "Father, the time has come"?
questions.explanation: Jesus said these things, then lifted up his eyes to heaven and spoke to the Father.

answers.text: He knelt down in a garden
He lifted up his eyes to heaven
He stretched out his hands
He wrote on the ground

questions.text: What does Jesus say eternal life is?
questions.explanation: He says this is eternal life, that they should know the only true God, and him whom he sent, Jesus Christ.

answers.text: To keep the whole law of Moses
To be glorified above the angels
To be sent into the world as he was
To know the only true God and Jesus Christ

questions.text: What did Jesus say he had accomplished on the earth?
questions.explanation: He said that he glorified the Father on the earth and accomplished the work the Father gave him to do.

answers.text: The work the Father gave him to do
The judgment of the world
The gathering of all nations
The building of the temple

questions.text: With what glory does Jesus ask the Father to glorify him?
questions.explanation: He asks the Father to glorify him with the glory which he had with the Father before the world existed.

answers.text: The glory of the kings of the earth
The glory that the world gives
The glory he had before the world existed
A glory never given to anyone

questions.text: For whom does Jesus say he prays?
questions.explanation: He says he prays for those whom the Father has given him, and not for the world, for they are the Father's.

answers.text: The whole world without exception
The rulers of the Jews only
Himself alone
Those whom the Father gave him

questions.text: What does Jesus ask the Holy Father to do for those who stay in the world?
questions.explanation: He asks the Father to keep them through his name, so that they may be one, even as they are one.

answers.text: Take them out of the world
Keep them, so that they may be one
Send them away to other nations
Glorify them before the world

questions.text: What does Jesus pray instead of asking that they be taken from the world?
questions.explanation: He prays not that the Father would take them from the world, but that he would keep them from the evil one.

answers.text: That they be given glory now
That they be made rulers in the world
That they be kept from the evil one
That they be hidden from the Jews

questions.text: What does Jesus say is truth?
questions.explanation: He asks the Father to sanctify them in his truth, and says that his word is truth.

answers.text: The Father's word
The law of Moses
The praise of the world
His own glory

questions.text: For whom else does Jesus pray, besides those already given to him?
questions.explanation: He says he prays not for these only, but also for those who will believe in him through their word.

answers.text: The rulers of the synagogue
Those who hated him
The soldiers and the officers
Those who will believe through their word

questions.text: What does Jesus desire for those whom the Father has given him?
questions.explanation: He desires that they also be with him where he is, so that they may see the glory the Father gave him.

answers.text: To stay in the world forever
To be with him and see his glory
To be glorified above him
To know nothing of his glory
